'''Mpalityan''' (Mpalitjanh) is an Australian language once spoken in the [[Cape York Peninsula]] of [[Queensland]]. It and [[Luthigh language|Luthigh]] are dialects of a single language.<ref>RMW Dixon (2002), ''Australian Languages: Their Nature and Development'', p xxxi</ref>
